title: Super admin wallet
footNote: Super admin wallet · private use · its own database, its own sign-in
isolationNote: This account is fully separate. Cash in or out here never touches the Bhabaghure Holidays balance or any other business ledger — it is the super admin’s own cash record.

errors.network: The wallet couldn’t be reached. Check the connection and try again.

signIn.title: Open the wallet
signIn.locksTitle: Only you can open the wallet
signIn.locksNote: Each lock is checked in turn. You are already past the first.
signIn.lockPlaceNote: This connection is on the wallet’s list of allowed addresses.
signIn.lockYouNote: Your admin email and password, then a code from the authenticator app on your phone.
signIn.sessionNote: The wallet keeps its own session: signing in here doesn’t sign you in to the admin panel, or the other way round.
signIn.passwordHint: The same password as the admin panel.
signIn.forgotLink: Reset it on the admin panel
signIn.enrollStep1: Open an authenticator app on your phone: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
signIn.enrollShowQr: Using another phone? Show the QR code
signIn.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
signIn.secretLabel: Can’t scan it? Type this key instead:
signIn.enrollOnce: The code and key show only until the first code is accepted. Don’t keep a screenshot of them.
signIn.codeNote: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the 6-digit code for “Bhabaghure wallet”. It changes every 30 seconds.
signIn.stepOpen: This step stays open for 5 minutes.
signIn.lostPhone: Lost your phone? The developer can reset the authenticator on the server; you then set it up again here.

notices.session_ended: Your wallet session ended (30 minutes without activity, or 12 hours in all). Sign in again to carry on.

cash.referenceIn: Reference · what this money is for
cash.evidenceNote: Receipt, bank slip or bKash screenshot · image or PDF, up to 5 MB
cash.evidenceChosen: Encrypted when saved · tap × to remove
cash.evidenceTooBig: Over 5 MB: attach a smaller photo or scan
